crew.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.

details.biography: Charmaine Calderon Balcerzak was born and raised in Chicago, IL, and became a multicultural hairstylist. She joined the entertainment industry in 2018 as an IATSE hair union member out of NY and resides in Atlanta. The change that took place from being a salon stylist owner to joining the hair/makeup union opened the doors for her creativity as a hair artist. Since joining the union, she has been trained by top elite hairstylists who have won Oscars and Emmy awards. From period, futuristic to current hairstyling training in the UK and US, she continues her ongoing education to never stop learning, which shows her work on the big screen. Charmaine has an MBA in business administration/management with an emphasis in marketing. Which has given her the ability to succeed and understand the business in the film and television industry. She is always staying positive and being grateful for what she has. She loves to travel, has a home in Colorado, and loves spending time with her family and friends enjoying the beautiful, majestic mountains.
details.name: Charmaine Balcerzak
